why: Under the alternative_group rule, "one or more programming languages such as Python and C++" and "Deep expertise on ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX)" each offer examples for a single ask, so each set is one group, while "machine-learning" stays out as the broad parent.
